subject: 8th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: The events occur on the 8th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: ## 8th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: Sava game set
fact: A Sava game set is present on a zurkhwood table in the guard chamber.
source_quote: It contains a zurkhwood table and three chairs, a smaller side table, and a Sava game set on the table

subject: Silken Paths
fact: The Silken Paths are a network of spiderwebs and strands in the Underdark used as travel routes.
source_quote: We are at the Silken Paths.

subject: Darklake
fact: The Darklake is a large body of water in the Underdark without a conventional surface, formed by intersecting caverns and tunnels.
source_quote: The Darklake is a large body of water. Unlike the overbrite, it doesn’t have a surface in the conventional sense. It’s a large water balloon in the Underdark, where intersecting caverns, caves, and tunnels allow navigation.

subject: Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is a location the group is heading toward after the Silken Paths.
source_quote: We have been heading towards Sloobludop.

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: Gracklstugh is a large Derro city where the group plans to acquire weapons and gear.
source_quote: Gracklstugh is a large Derro city. That’s where we can get weapons and gear.

subject: Velkynvelve
fact: The group started their journey in Velkynvelve.
source_quote: We started in Velkynvelve.

subject: Netheril
fact: Netheril was a great empire of magic whose flying cities fell centuries ago.
source_quote: After the fall of the empire of Netheril and its flying cities

subject: Brysis of Khaem
fact: Brysis of Khaem was a half-elf sorcerer interred in a floating tomb during the height of Faerûn’s magical empires.
source_quote: the half-elf sorcerer Brysis of Khaem was interred in a floating tomb.

subject: false tomb
fact: A false tomb contains a sarcophagus and burial chamber meant to deceive treasure hunters.
source_quote: they find a sarcophagus and a burial chamber. And that is a fake burial chamber.

subject: servants' tomb
fact: The real treasure is hidden in a secret passageway accessed from the servants' tomb.
source_quote: The real treasure is hidden in another chamber that you reach from a secret passageway from the servants' tomb.

subject: Fargas Rumblefoot
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot claims to know the location of Brysis’s tomb but admits he only knows it 'sort of' on the eastern edge of the Darklake.
source_quote: I don’t know the precise location. But I do know where it is -sort- of. It’s on the eastern edge of the Darklake.

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir claims to know the precise location of Brysis’s tomb after hearing Fargas’s description.
source_quote: I know where it must be. I can get us there.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum took notes while Fargas spoke about Brysis’s tomb.
source_quote: I took notes while you were talking,

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir touches Fargas’s belly to check for gnoll spawn.
source_quote: Zalthir then walks up to Fargas and touches his belly.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin learned the hill strike battle technique from a hill giant battle master.
source_quote: leveraging an old battle technique called a hill strike, which he learned from a hill giant battle master.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz uses magic missiles to attack the Spectator.
source_quote: Daz strikes with magic missiles.

subject: Yukyuk
fact: Yukyuk suggests sliding under the spiders and cutting the web from the other side as a better tactic.
source_quote: Like dudes, that was cool. But you might want to have thought about sliding -under- the spiders and cutting the web from the other side.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait criticizes the use of magic as cheating in the game of cut-the-graph.
source_quote: And like, using Magic is okay, but like, it’s kind of a cheat.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido suggests going to Gracklstugh after reaching Sloobludop.
source_quote: Buppido says we should go to Gracklstugh.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar accepts a bet from Grygum that he cannot convince the Spectator they are not demons, and fails.
source_quote: Jimjar, I’ll make a bet you can’t convince him that we are not demons and not enemies.

subject: Giant Spiders
fact: Giant Spiders are attacking the group and use web-spinning to build new bridges during the escape.
source_quote: the Spiders advance on the group... they use their web-spinning ability to build new bridges and advance along those bridges.

subject: Spectator
fact: A Spectator, a type of Beholder, attacks the group with confusion and paralysis rays.
source_quote: a floating sphere with a gaping maw and a single great eye, set within four eyestalks... I bring warnings of Demons... The creature, later revealed to be a Spectator, a kind of Beholder is quite mad and attacks.

subject: mimic
fact: A mimic is present as a large chest along the strand the group walks on.
source_quote: they see a large chest... all agree it’s a mimic.

subject: Drow
fact: Drow are pursuing the escapees through the Silken Paths.
source_quote: the Drow pursuers

subject: Derro
fact: Derro are the inhabitants of Gracklstugh, a large city the group plans to reach.
source_quote: Gracklstugh is a large Derro city.

subject: cutting a strand
fact: Zalthir cuts one of the strands in the web network, surprising the Giant Spiders.
source_quote: when Zalthir cuts one of the strands

subject: Spiders building bridges
fact: The Giant Spiders use web-spinning to build new bridges instead of attacking from a distance.
source_quote: they use their web-spinning ability to build new bridges and advance along those bridges.

subject: group escaping by cutting strands
fact: The group runs and cuts strands to force the Spiders to build new bridges instead of attacking.
source_quote: the group starts running and cutting strands, which causes the Spiders to keep creating strands.

subject: Spectator's mind attack
fact: The Spectator reaches out with its mind and begins talking to the group.
source_quote: It reaches out with its mind and starts talking - “I bring warnings!”

subject: Spectator accuses Zalthir of being a demon
fact: The Spectator accuses Zalthir of possibly being a demon or working for the Drow.
source_quote: Maybe you are a demon! Maybe you weren’t prisoners of the Drow but worked for the Drow. Maybe that Drow is your master!

subject: Spectator paralyzes Zalthir
fact: The Spectator emits an eerie green ray that paralyzes Zalthir.
source_quote: One of the eyestalks, meanwhile, emits an eerie green ray, and Zalthir is now paralyzed.

subject: Spectator’s blue ray strikes Thorin
fact: A blue ray from the Spectator strikes Thorin, but he is unaffected.
source_quote: A blue ray from another eyestalk strikes Thorin, but Thorin is unaffected.

subject: Thorin uses hill strike on Spectator
fact: Thorin uses a hill strike technique against the Spectator, but fails to knock it prone.
source_quote: Thorin swings his sword, leveraging an old battle technique called a hill strike... but the Spectator is stronger than the dwarf expected.

subject: Daz casts magic missiles
fact: Daz unleashes swift darts of pure magic that kill the Spectator.
source_quote: Glowing teardrops of blue-white force sizzle through the air, swooping swift as starlings, unerring in their flight. The Spectator is dead.

subject: Zalthir attacks Spectator while hanging from web
fact: Zalthir attempts to strike the Spectator while hanging from a spiderweb but misses.
source_quote: While hanging on the spiderweb, he attempts to strike the creature. Unfortunately, the effort to hold on and attack is too much, and he misses.

subject: Grygum fires crossbow at Spectator
fact: Grygum fires his handheld crossbow at the Spectator.
source_quote: He then takes his handheld crossbow and fires at the creature.

subject: group reaches edge of cavern wall
fact: The escapees reach the edge of the cavern wall and see a large chest.
source_quote: the escapees see the edge of the cavern wall. Along the strand they are walking, they see a large chest.

subject: group passes mimic
fact: The group passes the mimic without testing it, agreeing it is a mimic.
source_quote: all agree it’s a mimic. Even Buppido agrees.

subject: Jimjar promises payment to goblin guides
fact: Jimjar promises Yukyuk and Spiderbait they will receive their money when he gets it.
source_quote: I am good for it, but not right now. I promise you’ll get your money.

subject: goblin guides decide to stay with group
fact: Yukyuk and Spiderbait decide to stay with the escapees after witnessing Zalthir’s spiderweb maneuver.
source_quote: Yukyuk and Spiderbait are tempted to abandon the escapees, but Zalthir's slick, kick-ass move elevates them in the two guides' imaginations. And so they decide to stay with the escapees.

subject: Zalthir touches Fargas’s belly
fact: Zalthir touches Fargas’s belly to determine if he has gnoll spawn.
source_quote: Zalthir then walks up to Fargas and touches his belly.

subject: Zalthir declares no gnoll spawn
fact: Zalthir announces that Fargas is not a gnoll spawn.
source_quote: No gnoll spawn.

subject: Sethir draws map with Ormu
fact: Sethir uses the Ormu collected from the narrow tunnel to draw a map of their location and route.
source_quote: He uses the Ormu that Zalthir had collected from the narrow tunnel they had squeezed through.

subject: group begins walking on stone
fact: After passing the mimic, the group walks onto stone instead of spiderweb.
source_quote: Once past the mimic, the group is on stone, and the endless tunnels of the Underdark beckon.

subject: Buppido's divine plan
fact: Buppido suggests Zalthir might be part of his divine plan after overhearing Daz’s comment about using guides as fodder.
source_quote: Buppido overhears the two and turns to Zalthir, “What an interesting idea, Zalthir. Perhaps you can be part of my divine plan.

subject: Spectator’s suspicion of Buppido
fact: Zalthir wonders whether the Spectator thought Buppido was the demon, but dismisses the idea.
source_quote: Zalthir wonders whether the Spectator thought Buppido was the demon, but he pushes that idea aside

subject: Ormu
fact: Ormu is a substance collected by Zalthir from a narrow tunnel and used by Sethir to draw a map.
source_quote: He uses the Ormu that Zalthir had collected from the narrow tunnel they had squeezed through.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is referenced as the authority who decides the fate of failed Drow.
source_quote: Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Serith's

subject: Serith
fact: Serith is referenced as a failed Drow whose fate is used as a comparison.
source_quote: Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Serith's

subject: Cormyr
fact: Cormyr is a region where a magical variation of cut-the-graph is played by militaries.
source_quote: A particular variation played in Cormyr, where militaries are far more sophisticated

subject: gaming halls across Faerûn
fact: Gaming halls across Faerûn expel players who use the Cormyr rules for cut-the-graph.
source_quote: in several gaming halls across Faerûn, playing with the Cormyr rules will get you expelled from the gaming hall.

subject: spiderweb in Fargas’s hair
fact: Fargas removes spiderweb still stuck in his hair and equipment before recounting the tale of Brysis’s tomb.
source_quote: He sits down, picks some spiderweb still in his hair and his equipment, and begins

subject: scrap of paper
fact: Grygum holds a scrap of paper containing notes on Fargas’s description of Brysis’s tomb.
source_quote: Grygum pulls out a scrap of paper, says, “I took notes while you were talking,”

subject: Fargas admits to keeping his bargain
fact: Fargas Rumblefoot admits he must keep his end of the bargain after Grygum repeats his words.
source_quote: He sighs, “I suppose I should keep my end of the bargain.”

subject: Zalthir questions Fargas’s truthfulness
fact: Zalthir realizes Fargas claimed to know the tomb’s location before but now says he only knows it 'sort of'.
source_quote: It is interesting that he said he knew where it was previously but doesn’t know now.

subject: Grygum’s assessment of Fargas
fact: Grygum declares that Fargas was not lying and is not lying now.
source_quote: Fargas wasn’t -lying- and he isn’t lying.

subject: Sethir claims knowledge of tomb location
fact: Sethir declares he knows where the tomb is after hearing Fargas’s description.
source_quote: I know where it must be. I can get us there.

subject: Thorin critiques map accuracy
fact: Thorin observes that Sethir’s map does not reflect relative distances accurately.
source_quote: The map doesn’t reflect the relative distances accurately.

subject: Sethir answers distance to Sloobludop
fact: Sethir says the group is three days from Sloobludop.
source_quote: Sethir answers, “Three days.”

subject: Spiderbait explains Drow pursuit likelihood
fact: Spiderbait explains that Drow pursuers may or may not be slowed depending on whether they have good guides.
source_quote: Depends if they have good guides. And there are hundreds of ways of going through the Silken Paths. Yukyuk and I just happen to know the best way. If they have a good guide, no. A bad guide? Yes.

subject: Yukyuk praises Zalthir’s spiderweb maneuver
fact: Yukyuk praises Zalthir’s skill in walking under the spiderweb and attacking the Spectator.
source_quote: That was some next-level spider walking. Like going underneath the spider web and attacking the creature.

subject: large chest
fact: A large chest is seen along the strand after the mimic, and the group assumes it is a mimic.
source_quote: they see a large chest. There is a momentary desire to see if it’s a treasure chest, but all agree it’s a mimic.

subject: Zalthir considers convincing guides to retrieve mimic treasure
fact: Zalthir privately wonders if he could convince the goblin guides to retrieve the treasure from the mimic.
source_quote: Zalthir privately wonders if they could convince the two guides to get the gold from the mimic.

subject: Daz’s comment about guides as fodder
fact: Daz mutters that the goblin guides might prove useful as fodder in a battle.
source_quote: They might prove useful as fodder in a battle.
